<!-- pr-reviewer: 1fe9b51d197bb44ba151f5a329176d5f51aa624c -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (reviewed at the HIGH tier: collision and link routing).

### What looks good
- A struck link is re-laid as retract, traverse, plunge only when the gate's own law (`fixture_struck::path_hits`, the same function the post gate and generation warnings now call - `fixture_struck.rs:66`, `generate.rs` `workholding_warnings`) flags it, and the re-laid link is judged again by that same law (`fixture_route.rs` `plan_links`). A link that still strikes is left as laid, keeps its `FixtureHit` (post blocked) and gets a path note - it is never silently passed.
- Refusals are by name: the unclearable case returns `GenError::Invalid` naming the fixture, the link's move range and XY ends, the steel top and the Z stroke top (`fixture_route.rs:~128`). Cap uses `floor`ed ceiling and keeps `MIN_GAP`.
- Conservative scope: upright mills only; posed/rotary paths, lathe tools, canned cycles, thread/probe records, arcs, compensated spans and keep-down feeds stay report-only (a feed is never lifted, so no cut can be skipped). No-fixture and already-clear documents return untouched, so goldens are unchanged.
- Safe indexing (`get`/`take`/`skip`, `saturating_sub`), no unwrap/expect/panic, provenance line present, decision file `docs/decisions/339-fixture-routing.md` present, no process/build/dependency files touched, no snapshot or golden changes.
- Mutation check: with `plan_links` short-circuited to return the path unchanged, 6 of 7 `fixture_route` tests fail (only the "already clear stays byte for byte" test passes, as it should). So the tests do prove a crossing link is re-routed or refused.

### Local results (merged with `upstream/main`, which was already up to date - no conflicts)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `fixture_route` | 7 passed |
| `fixtures` | 14 passed |
| `fixture_mesh` | 3 passed |
| `fixture_law_gaps` | 3 passed |
| `fixture_ux` | 9 passed |
| `posting` | 17 passed |
| `tool_body` | 8 passed |
| `camcraft-app --lib` | 107 passed |
| `clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

UI suites not run: no UI file changed.

### Requested before merge
None.

### Notes (not blocking)
1. `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs` is 3243 lines (was 3230) - already far over the ~400-line law; the hook adds 13 lines. The router itself is its own 267-line module, so the growth is minimal.
2. The body has `Changelog:` and `Refs #339` (partial slice, so no `Fixes`) but no `Effort:` line; the dispatcher's cost comment carries it.
3. The PR says it changes posted G-code for struck documents and wants a Hub or machine run with a clamp between features; that hands-on check is the maintainer's call.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
